title: Shared capture-zoom helper typed to Render_Ctx excludes palcheck's three restated LOOK §1 altitude transforms
detail: The math is pure View state (view_refit/zoom_rung_of/camera_fit), but the ^Render_Ctx signature means palcheck's three inline altitude transforms cannot share it — the exact restated-copy-drifts-a-rung hazard the comment names.
recommended_fix: Type it proc(v: ^rnd.View, zoom_in: f32) (callers pass &rc.view) so palcheck's bare-View altitude legs can adopt the ONE derivation instead of restating it.

title: scan_col_v inserted between measure_color_run's doc comment and its proc
detail: The diff pasted scan_col_v between measure_color_run's doc comment and its proc, orphaning that comment ~24 lines above its function inside a stacked comment blob (count_exact + measure_color_run + scan_col_v).
recommended_fix: Move the scan_col_v comment + proc above measure_color_run's doc block (or below its proc) so each comment stays adjacent to its proc.
